item.title: 🟠 Critical Everest Forms Pro flaw exploited to take over WordPress sites
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Hackers are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-3300) in the Everest Forms Pro plugin, which lets them take complete control of a WordPress website. [...]
